atoms.reason: Baselines already compare criteria and evidence roles. Isolated local gains in calibration did not establish a recurring missing writing ability; the final fresh task retained a concise gain on one route but introduced unsupported population transfer on two. Additional default prose guidance has not demonstrated stable net benefit.

Baselines already state findings and interpretation. Isolation retained a useful concrete exception analysis on one route, but did not consistently reduce work-list repetition or revision burden across the fresh task and two writer families.

The observed-question versus available-material distinction produced useful local phrasing, but was already partly present in baseline rules and drafts; fresh work did not reliably gain this distinction and sometimes broadened a limited reading set into a field-wide claim.

review_policy: Inspect original drafts and source cards; do not use raw reviewer majority or treat length as a factual error. Decisions concern these exact wording patches, not the value of the underlying writing distinctions.
limits: Single first sample per task, route and arm; no repeated-sampling causal estimate.
Alibaba and Ollama 0731 routes are not independent model families; returned labels do not attest underlying weights.
Exact entry and one leaf supplied through a no-tool API context; routing, installation, Hook and long-form continuity were not tested.
Six technical failures and one delivery failure are retained; no success rate is reported as a prose-quality pass rate.
